name: How can I prevent pipes from making noise?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent pipes from making noise?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing pipe noise often involves addressing common causes like water hammer, loose pipes, and high water pressure. You can install water hammer arrestors on quick-closing fixtures, secure loose pipes with additional strapping, or have a plumber install a pressure reducing valve if your water pressure is too high. Regular plumbing maintenance and prompt attention to minor issues can also help keep your pipes quiet and in good condition.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent pipe noise by installing water hammer arrestors, securing loose pipes, and managing high water pressure with a pressure reducing valve.
